products.description:
Smooth, sheer and brimming with skincare actives, the Umbra Sheer™ Mineral Cream SPF30 (60ml) is a physical sunscreen suited to all skin types and tones. 
 Powered by 20% zinc oxide to block out the sun's harmful rays, this fast-absorbing formula is ideal for daily use. Non-pilling, it's perfect for wearing under any make up products, or slathered on solo thanks to its tone-unifying pink tint.
